entries.en: Lookin' for some nice threads. Nothin' tacky.
What's trendin' on the street right now?
entries.ro: Ce se poartă pe stradă acum?

entries.en: Forget about other people. You need to express yourself. Show this city know who YOU are.
entries.ro: Uită de alți oameni. Trebuie să te exprimi. Arată orașului ăstuia cine ești TU.

entries.en: We'll find you something dapper in no time.
entries.ro: Îți găsim ceva elegant într-o clipă.

entries.en: How long've you been running this place?
entries.ro: De cât timp conduci locul ăsta?

entries.en: You been runnin' this place long?
Few years now. Used to be a fashion designer.
entries.ro: De câțiva ani. Eram designer de modă.

entries.en: Same thing that's happening everywhere – gave the job to some algorithm. Program can spit out a thousand new designs in a second. Can't compete with that.
entries.ro: La fel ca peste tot – au dat jobul unui algoritm. Programul scoate o mie de modele noi într-o secundă. Nu poți concura cu asta.

entries.en: Stuck on where to take my style. Anything you'd recommend?
entries.en_m: Stuck on where I wanna take my style. Anything you'd recommend?
entries.ro: Mă tot gândesc încotro să-mi duc stilul. Ai ceva de recomandat?
